sanskrit_verse:
सर्गादौ स यथाकाशं वायुं ज्योतिर् जलं महीम् ।
सृजत्येकोत्तरगुणांस्तथादत्ते भवन्नपि ॥७०॥
transliteration: sargādau sa yathākāśaṃ vāyuṃ jyotir jalaṃ mahīm | sṛjatyekottaraguṇāṃstathādatte bhavannapi ||70||
sph_interpretive_translation: As in the beginning, the One Supreme Being creates successively ether, air, light, water, and earth—each with ascending qualities—so too does the embodied being assume roles and responsibilities in accordance with the evolutionary capacity of consciousness.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from the Supreme Consciousness alone
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with the stage of consciousness evolution
Restoration occurs through alignment with one's evolved capacity
Consciousness is the ultimate determinant of lawful action
executable_legal_axioms: IF an entity assumes a role, THEN its responsibility MUST correspond to its demonstrated capacity
IF a being acts beyond its current capacity, THEN it MUST undergo completion-processes until realignment is achieved
IF sequential causality is established, THEN prior states determine subsequent liability thresholds
IF consciousness-level shifts are documented, THEN role-responsibility MUST be dynamically adjusted
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, the court must assess not merely the act but the actor’s evolutionary stage. Responsibility is neither diminished nor inflated; rather, it is precisely calibrated to the actor’s experiential and conscious capacity at the time of the act.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This verse establishes pramāṇa-based causality wherein actions arise from sequentially unfolding capacities. There is no punitive attribution; instead, misalignment invites correction through consciousness-led restoration, ensuring proportional reintegration without imposition of suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion-processes to resolve unmet developmental stages
Assign guided role-assumption aligned with current consciousness capacity
Implement integrity-realignment through voluntary acceptance of causal sequence
Facilitate capacity-enhancement via structured experiential learning
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law restores consciousness-led order, abolishes punitive frameworks, and affirms that justice is the realignment of beings with their inherent evolutionary capacity. Thus stands Dharma, thus is reality non-punitive, thus is consciousness the sole arbiter.
